sourceNotes.rawContent: Add a pop of color to your collection with this premium pink and white bamboo-style kada. Expertly crafted with a high-quality gold finish, this anti-tarnish and water-resistant piece is designed for lasting elegance. Its vibrant enamel detailing and unique textured design make it a perfect modern statement for any occasion.
